summary: 2026-27 board from the Oct 25 Annual Meeting and the Nov 1 board meeting: five officers (President as the lead card), every other seat grouped by what parents ask about with role emails, and a Get involved block (open Umpire in Chief seat, the new Fields Committee, the Dec 6 meeting, the October vote).
blurb: Who is on the 2026-27 board and how to reach each role.

sources.fact: The Annual Board Meeting on Sunday Oct 25, 2026 welcomed 11 new board members; some seats were still open, and anyone interested, even a little, was invited to the next meeting.
Next board meeting: Sunday Nov 1, 2026, 6 to 8 PM, Round Table Pizza in Bonney Lake.

All board positions are voted on; known openings included Umpire in Chief and Fields Committee (2+); General Membership Meeting Sunday Oct 25, 6 to 8 PM, Round Table Pizza in Bonney Lake; position descriptions are in the BLSLL Constitution.
The 2026 board was voted in during October 2025, so the board vote happens each October.
The Fields Committee is recruiting members for the upcoming season.

Nov 1 board meeting: Mandie Pitingoro voted in as VP of Challenger and Zach Thibodeau as Softball AA/Coach Pitch Player Agent; Fields Committee created to keep fields safe and ready for play and to recruit volunteers; Jason Guertin kept on as Fields Assistant; next meeting Dec 6, 6 to 8 PM, Round Table Pizza Bonney Lake.
Correct spelling is Zach Thibodeau (board GroupMe, Nov 4; the Nov 1 minutes spell it Thibodeu). Umpire in Chief was not addressed Nov 1 and is still open.
